article.title: Punishment for aggravated sexual assault.
article.content: Whoever, commits aggravated sexual assault shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than five years but which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.

10Punishment for aggravated sexual assault.

Section 10 · Chapter II · Aggravated Sexual Assault and Punishment Therefor · page 8 of the Act

Whoever, commits aggravated sexual assault shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which shall not be less than five years but which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
